Problem: Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the numbers 5280 and 12155.

<reflection>
The Euclidean algorithm is an appropriate method for finding the GCD of 5280 and 12155. The computation begins with GCD(5280, 12155). Applying the Euclidean algorithm requires dividing 12155 by 5280 and finding the remainder.
This equation is incorrect because 5280 × 2 = 10560, and 12155 − 10560 = 1595, not 1335.
Recompute the remainder of 12155 divided by 5280 as 1595 and continue the Euclidean algorithm with GCD(5280, 1595).
</reflection>
